name: Fluff Crush
source:
After moving away for 12 years, you return to your hometown of Shrewscola for a week to watch over your uncle's home while he's away.
Take the time to reconnect with an old friend and forge new connections with the colorful locals in Fluff Crush!

[From [url=https://khaoti.itch.io/fluff-crush-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
离开家乡12年后，你回到Shrewscola，打算在叔叔外出期间照看他的房子，为期一周。
抽空与老朋友重叙旧谊，再和当地形形色色的人结识、建立新的联系吧！

[来源：[url=https://khaoti.itch.io/fluff-crush-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
